title: Trapping Rain Water

story.title: Storm Over the Pixel City
story.text: Rain falls on a row of brick towers. Two surveyors start at both ends, each remembering the tallest tower they have passed. The side with the shorter tallest tower is safe to settle: water there is that height minus the tower.
story.goal: Return how many water tiles get trapped between the towers.

legend.meaning: water already settled behind the surveyors
